versions.changelog:
AutoPlot 0.1.0 initial release.

- Instantly visualizes CSV, Excel, or JSON data files via one simple command—no coding needed.
- Auto-detects data types and relationships, automatically selecting the optimal chart (line, bar, scatter, pie, etc.).
- Generates charts in PNG, SVG, interactive HTML, and PDF formats with customizable themes and output options.
- Supports multi-chart dashboards, data analysis, custom chart titles, and styling through command-line options.
- Designed for quick insights, data exploration, and generating ready-to-share visualizations from any tabular data.
